title: Trace European post-indexed lower reader sites
changes: Record original reader-site witnesses for the 108 post-indexed sampled bytes outside E226 and create a pending extraction and consumption checklist for the matching literals.
validation: Wine site capture qpmxbv2e observes all 27 targeted words in the retained 12-frame E170 continuation; nine instruction-scoped read records match original Thumb LDR opcode/address pairs, and 19 distinct reads are outside instruction scopes. Wine drained.
limitations: Scopes may include nested HLE or DMA reads; witnesses do not establish every caller, full source extents or complete scene equivalence. The capture publishes no source and 72 other sampled bytes remain unattributed.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance comparison was performed.
